verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is a compliance and AML screening platform, and document-capture SDKs are a plausible capability for a KYC/compliance vendor, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only API-based screening, risk scoring, webhooks, case management, and Postman/OpenAPI resources. It contains no native iOS, Android, or web SDKs and no guided camera capture with glare, blur, or edge coaching.
